title: BizFlood Loss Settlement Basis and Coinsurance Schedule
content:
For BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines), each tier fixes the coinsurance percentage applied to building and contents at the time of loss, whether coinsurance can be suspended for the term on a signed statement of values (agreed value), and the basis on which building losses and business personal property losses are settled.

## Schedule

| Tier | Coinsurance percentage | Agreed value available | Building losses settled at | Business personal property losses settled at |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BizFlood Building | 80 | No | Replacement cost | Actual cash value |
| BizFlood Building and Contents | 80 | No | Replacement cost | Actual cash value |
| BizFlood Building, Contents and Business Income | 80 | Yes | Replacement cost | Replacement cost |
| BizFlood Excess over NFIP | 80 | No | Replacement cost | Replacement cost |
| BizFlood Multi-Location | 80 | Yes | Replacement cost | Replacement cost |
| BizFlood Large Property | 90 | Yes | Replacement cost | Replacement cost |

## Terms used

- **Coinsurance percentage** — the percentage applied to building and contents at loss: 80 percent on five tiers and 90 percent on BizFlood Large Property.
- **Agreed value** — the suspension of coinsurance for the term on a signed statement of values. It can be written on BizFlood Building, Contents and Business Income, BizFlood Multi-Location and BizFlood Large Property; it cannot be written on BizFlood Building, BizFlood Building and Contents or BizFlood Excess over NFIP.
- **Settlement basis** — the two bases are actual cash value and replacement cost. Building losses are settled at replacement cost on every tier. Business personal property losses are settled at actual cash value on BizFlood Building and BizFlood Building and Contents, and at replacement cost on the other four tiers.

## Illustration (hypothetical value)

A hypothetical location valued at 2,000,000 at the time of loss carries a coinsurance requirement of 80 percent of that value, 1,600,000, on BizFlood Multi-Location, and of 90 percent of that value, 1,800,000, on BizFlood Large Property.
